payload.title: File:Dawazisaurus brevis holotype replica NTM.jpg
payload.description_html: Replica of Dawazisaurus brevis holotype (NMNS000933-F034397). Found in lower Middle Triassic Guanling Formation in Dawazi, Yunnan, China, the specimen is a collection of the National Museum of Natural Science (Taichung, Taiwan). This replica was loaned to the National Taiwan Museum and was on display during a special exhibition. The white patch on the lower right was a glass-reflected light.
